selector.rationale: The presence of a complex and septated mass in the subcutaneous tissue near the coccyx, with no involvement of the coccyx or anal sphincter, and the lack of fluctuance, purulence, or visible pilonidal pits, supports the diagnosis of Epidermoid cyst.

rejected.label: Ependymoma
rejected.why: The location and characteristics of the mass do not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Soft tissue tumor
rejected.why: While this is a possible diagnosis, the characteristics of the mass are more consistent with Epidermoid cyst
